title: Best Vremi Dehumidifier (2026): 22, 35 and 50-Pint Compared
dek: Vremi makes friendly, affordable dehumidifiers in three sizes. Here's which one fits your space — and what independent data says about how fast they work.
description: Which Vremi dehumidifier should you buy? We compare the 22-, 35- and 50-pint Moisture Maniac models on coverage, features, warranty and independent results.
intro: A **Vremi dehumidifier** is one of the more affordable ways into a name-brand compressor unit, and the lineup is refreshingly simple: three sizes — 22, 35 and 50 pints — sharing the same basic controls, wheels and auto shut-off. The trick is matching the size to your space and knowing where Vremi's value positioning shows up.

Vremi isn't an HVAC specialist. It's a New York consumer-goods company founded in 2016 that started with cookware and later added dehumidifiers, ice makers, air conditioners and air fryers. That's not a knock — plenty of good appliances come from generalist brands — but it does mean you should look closely at the data. Helpfully, one independent reviewer ran a Vremi 50-pint unit through the same side-by-side test as rival brands, and we factor that in below.
topPicksLead: For most bedrooms, offices and small apartments, the **Vremi 22-Pint** is the one to buy: ENERGY STAR certified, quiet, and right-sized for a single room.

products.name: Vremi 22-Pint Dehumidifier (VRM012001N)
pros: Auto shut-off when the tank fills
Turbo mode for a faster initial drawdown
cons: Roughly 1-gallon tank means frequent emptying in damp rooms
products.whyWeLoveIt: This is Vremi at its best: a compact, efficient unit that's easy to roll from room to room and quiet enough for a bedroom. It doesn't try to be a basement machine, and for one room it doesn't need to be.
products.performance: Vremi rates the 22-Pint for spaces up to about 1,500 square feet, with a roughly 1-gallon tank that shuts the unit off when full. It offers continuous 24-hour operation, a Turbo fan setting to pull a muggy room down quickly, and built-in wheels and a carry handle. ENERGY STAR certification keeps season-long running costs reasonable. To compare it with other one-room units, see our [best small dehumidifier](/best/best-small-dehumidifier/) picks.

products.name: Vremi 35-Pint Dehumidifier
products.whyWeLoveIt: If the 22-pint is a little small for your space — a large primary bedroom, a family room or a lightly damp finished basement — the 35-pint steps up capacity without adding complexity.
products.performance: Vremi rates this size for up to about 3,000 square feet and pairs it with a larger, roughly 1.4-gallon tank and automatic humidity regulation that cycles the compressor to hold your setting. Like the rest of the lineup, it drains by bucket or gravity hose only. It's a good fit for a mildly damp lower level, but a heavily wet basement calls for more.

products.name: Vremi Moisture Maniac 50-Pint Dehumidifier (VRM012003N)
pros: Accurate built-in humidity readout in independent results
cons: Slower drying than leading 50-pint rivals in one independent test
products.whyWeLoveIt: For a basement on a budget, the Moisture Maniac gives you full 50-pint capacity, a roomy tank and a drain connection for unattended running. Its humidity readout is also trustworthy, which isn't true of every budget unit.
products.performance: Vremi rates it for spaces up to about 4,500 square feet, with a 1.8-gallon (about 14.4-pint) tank and a continuous drain outlet. In an independent side-by-side comparison of an earlier Vremi 50-pint model, it took 11 minutes 50 seconds to bring a small test room from 90% to 40% humidity, versus about 10 minutes for a hOmeLabs and under 8 for the Frigidaire FFAD5033W1. Its built-in hygrometer read within 2–3% of actual humidity in the same comparison.
products.notes: If speed matters more than price, compare it with the units in our [basement dehumidifier guide](/best/best-dehumidifier-for-basement/).

blocks.text: Put together, those numbers sum up the brand: a trustworthy display and a clean safety record, paired with drying speed that trails the category leaders. Because it drew an ordinary 570 watts while taking longer to finish the job, that same reviewer rated the 50-pint below average on energy efficiency among the 50-pint units it compared.

We don't lab-test dehumidifiers ourselves. For this guide we gathered Vremi's own specifications (capacity, coverage, tank size, drainage and warranty), ENERGY STAR status, published independent test results, the CPSC recall database and patterns in owner reviews.
We then matched each size to the space it suits best and flagged where a competitor with more supporting data might be the smarter buy.

sections.heading: What to look for in a Vremi dehumidifier

items.label: Size by space, not just pints
items.text: Vremi maps its 22-, 35- and 50-pint units to about 1,500, 3,000 and 4,500 square feet. Measure first, then check our [size guide](/guides/dehumidifier-size-guide/).

items.label: Speed vs. price
items.text: If you're pulling down a very damp basement, a faster rival may be worth the extra money. For maintaining a room that's already near target, Vremi's pace is fine.

items.label: Drainage plan
items.text: No Vremi model has a pump. If your drain is above floor level, look at our [pump picks](/best/best-dehumidifier-with-pump/).

items.label: Warranty
items.text: Vremi covers its dehumidifiers for one year, shorter than some major brands.

sections.heading: The Vremi 22-pint dehumidifier: who it's for

blocks.text: The 22-pint is Vremi's most popular size for good reason. It's light, quiet, efficient and genuinely useful in the rooms where most people feel humidity: bedrooms, home offices and apartments. Use it with a gravity hose to a nearby drain if you don't want to empty the tank every day in midsummer.

blocks.title: When to size up
blocks.text: If the room smells musty, you see condensation on windows, or the tank fills more than once a day, step up to the 35-pint — or to a 50-pint for a basement.

sections.heading: Vremi dehumidifier manual, setup and care

items: **Find your model number** on the label on the back of the unit (for example, VRM012001N for the 22-pint). Vremi's manuals are model-specific.
**Get the manual** from the product listing where you bought it or by contacting Vremi's customer support with that model number.
**Let it stand upright** for a few hours before first use if it was shipped on its side, so the refrigerant settles.
**Clean the washable filter** every couple of weeks in heavy use.
**For continuous draining,** remove the tank, attach a hose to the drain outlet and run it downhill to a floor drain with no kinks.

blocks.text: If your Vremi runs but collects little water, see our [troubleshooting guide](/guides/dehumidifier-not-collecting-water/).

blocks.text: A couple of minutes in a small test room translates into hours in a real basement, so the gap matters most when you're drying out a genuinely wet space. If you mostly need to hold an already-reasonable room at 50%, the difference shrinks, and Vremi's lower price may win. For the faster rivals, see our [Frigidaire](/best/best-frigidaire-dehumidifier/) and [hOmeLabs](/best/best-homelabs-dehumidifier/) guides.

We found no dehumidifier recall tied to the Vremi name in the CPSC database. Several older brands can't say the same: units built on Midea and Gree platforms were swept into large fire-hazard recalls affecting brands such as Danby, GE, Frigidaire, Keystone and De'Longhi. Vremi is a newer, smaller-volume brand, so its clean record carries less weight than it would for a decades-old name, but it's still a point in its favor.

The **Vremi 22-Pint** is the best Vremi dehumidifier for most people — efficient, quiet and right for a bedroom or small apartment. The **35-Pint** covers a larger room, and the **Moisture Maniac 50-Pint** handles a mildly damp basement on a budget, with the caveat that it dries more slowly than the category leaders. To see how Vremi stacks up against other names, read our [best dehumidifier brands](/best/best-dehumidifier-brands/) roundup.

faqs.q: What is the best Vremi dehumidifier?
faqs.a: For most bedrooms and small apartments, the Vremi 22-Pint. It's ENERGY STAR certified, quiet and rated for about 1,500 square feet. Choose the 35-Pint for a medium room and the Moisture Maniac 50-Pint for a basement.
For a single room, yes. It's efficient, quiet and has auto shut-off plus a gravity-drain option. It's not designed for a damp basement, where a 50-pint unit is a better choice.

faqs.q: Is Vremi a reliable dehumidifier brand?
faqs.a: It's a solid value brand with no recalls on record and accurate humidity readouts. In one independent comparison, though, its 50-pint unit dried a room more slowly than comparable hOmeLabs and Frigidaire models.

Vremi LLC, a New York-based consumer-goods company founded in 2016. It began with cookware and small kitchen appliances and later expanded into dehumidifiers, ice makers, air conditioners and air fryers, so dehumidifiers are one product line among many rather than its core specialty.

faqs.q: Where can I find a Vremi dehumidifier manual?
faqs.a: Check the product listing where you bought it or contact Vremi customer support with the model number from the label on the back of your unit. Manuals differ by model, so match the number exactly.

faqs.q: Does the Vremi 50-pint dehumidifier have a pump?
faqs.a: No. None of Vremi's current models has a built-in pump. They drain into the internal tank or by gravity through a hose.

faqs.q: How long is the Vremi warranty?
faqs.a: One year on the unit, which is standard for budget brands but shorter than some major names.
